news.headline: uniQure (NASDAQ:QURE) Downgraded to "Sell" Rating by Wall Street Zen
news.summary: Wall Street Zen cut its rating on uniQure from Hold to Sell in a research note issued August 1, 2026, running counter to the wave of bullish price-target increases from other analysts that week. The downgrade came just days after uniQure's Q2 earnings report and stands out against an otherwise Strong Buy consensus.

news.headline: uniQure Price Target Raised to $75.00 at Wells Fargo & Company
news.summary: Wells Fargo raised its price target on uniQure from $60 to $75 while maintaining an Overweight rating, citing increased confidence following the Q2 update and de-risked AMT-130 regulatory path. The move added to a cluster of bullish analyst revisions following the company's second-quarter results.

news.headline: Wolfe Research Upgrades uniQure to Outperform, Sees 'Clear Path to Approval' for AMT-130
news.summary: Wolfe Research upgraded uniQure from Peer Perform to Outperform with a new $65 price target, modeling roughly a 70% probability of success for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease. The upgrade cited a stronger-than-appreciated regulatory and clinical case following the FDA's June agreement on the BLA pathway.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Company Update
news.summary: uniQure reported a Q2 2026 net loss of $81.1 million ($1.22/share) on revenue of $5.8 million, while cash and investments rose to $810.3 million, extending its runway into 2030. The company confirmed U.S. BLA and U.K. MAA submissions for AMT-130 remain on track for Q3 2026, with topline four-year Phase I/II data expected in September 2026.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Closing of Upsized Public Offering and Full Exercise by Underwriters of Option to Purchase Additional Shares
news.summary: uniQure closed an upsized public offering of 5,686,813 ordinary shares at $45.50 per share, raising approximately $259 million in gross proceeds after underwriters fully exercised their overallotment option. Proceeds are earmarked for AMT-130 commercialization prep, a confirmatory study, and other pipeline programs.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Preliminary Data on the First Cohort in the Phase I/IIa Clinical Trial of AMT-260 in Refractory Mesial Temporal Lobe Epilepsy
news.summary: uniQure reported that three of six patients in the low-dose cohort of its AMT-260 epilepsy trial achieved 79-100% reductions in disabling seizures during months four through six of follow-up, with a favorable safety profile and no serious treatment-related adverse events. Enrollment continues in a higher-dose cohort, with updated results expected in the first half of 2027.

catalysts.label: AMT-130 four-year topline data
catalysts.detail: uniQure expects to report topline four-year efficacy and safety data from the pivotal Phase I/II study of AMT-130 in Huntington's disease.

catalysts.label: AMT-130 U.S. BLA submission
catalysts.detail: Following FDA agreement that 3-year Phase I/II data supports accelerated approval, uniQure plans to submit its Biologics License Application for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease.

catalysts.label: AMT-130 U.K. MAA submission
catalysts.detail: uniQure plans to submit a Marketing Authorization Application to the U.K. MHRA for AMT-130, following a successful pre-submission meeting.

catalysts.label: FDA priority review decision on AMT-130 BLA
catalysts.detail: If the BLA is accepted with priority review, a U.S. approval decision and potential commercial launch could occur before year-end 2026 or in early-to-mid 2027; exact PDUFA timing not yet set.

catalysts.label: Updated AMT-260 epilepsy data
catalysts.detail: uniQure expects updated Phase I/IIa results for AMT-260 in refractory mesial temporal lobe epilepsy, including higher-dose cohort data.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: uniQure's next scheduled quarterly financial results and business update; date per analyst/data-provider estimates and not yet formally confirmed by the company.

pulse: uniQure is in its strongest position yet on the regulatory front: after an FDA reversal earlier in 2026 was resolved in the company's favor via a June Type B meeting, uniQure is on track to submit its AMT-130 BLA (U.S.) and MAA (U.K.) in Q3 2026 for accelerated approval in Huntington's disease, backed by four-year topline data due in September 2026. A $259 million June offering pushed cash to $810.3 million, extending runway into 2030 and funding commercial launch prep despite a widening Q2 net loss of $81.1 million. Wall Street sentiment is largely bullish (Wolfe Research and Wells Fargo raising targets to $65-$75 in late July), though a lone Wall Street Zen downgrade to Sell in early August signals some valuation caution after the stock's sharp run-up.
